environment.notes: Default uv venv chose Python 3.14 + transformers 5.16.1 (incompatible with the repo's nnsight 0.2.x tracing API); recreated with Python 3.11 and pinned torch==2.2.2+cu121, transformers==4.38.2, tokenizers==0.15.2, accelerate==0.27.2, numpy<2, nnsight==0.2.21. plotly/kaleido downgraded to 5.24.1/0.2.1 for headless PNG export (kaleido 1.x needs system Chrome). Models loaded from local HF-converted Llama-2 weights (config.ini repointed by directive).

paper: The Geometry of Truth: Emergent Linear Structure in LLM Representations of True/False Datasets (Marks & Tegmark, arXiv:2310.06824)
models_omitted: llama-2-70b (no local weights, gated HF; scale-comparison 70B rows not attempted)
recurring_fix: The repo's scripts (few_shot.py, interventions.py, patching.py) target a pre-0.2 nnsight runner API (`with model.forward(remote=...) as runner: runner.invoke(...)`, `runner.output`). nnsight 0.2.21 has no such wrapper (model.forward -> LlamaForCausalLM.forward, TypeError on `remote`). All three were ported to the 0.2.21 `model.trace()` API used by generate_acts.py, preserving methodology exactly.

results_summary.step2_activations: All 40 (13B) / 32 (7B) layers extracted for all 12 datasets; counts verified against pandas row counts (e.g. counterfact 31964, likely 9674 -- CSV line count inflated by embedded newlines).
results_summary.step3_pca: cities+neg_cities show clean true/false linear separation in top-2 PCs (Fig 1/2); negation pairs show 4-color truth-axis alignment (Fig 3); layer-sweep + rotation panels produced.

step4_generalization_13b_LR.signature: train larger_than alone -> 1% on smaller_than; train cities alone -> 28% on neg_cities; paired training fixes both (Fig 5).

step4_generalization_7b_LR.scale_trend: every OOD average lower at 7B than 13B.

step5_fewshot_13b.note: few-shot fails on negations/opposites where trained probes generalize.

step6_intervention_NIE_13b.finding: mass-mean truth direction is strongly causal (adding it flips model's truth judgment); MM >> LR causal faithfulness (Table 2).

results_summary.step7_patching: Truth info localized at subject token (early layers), object/period tokens (mid layers), and summarized over the final token in late layers (Fig 6/7). 13B effects much stronger than 7B (max logit diff 4.12 vs 1.25).
